mapper.select: SELECT A.BBS_ID AS bbsId , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.BBS_NM_KEY AS bbsNmKey , B.MESSAGE_CN AS bbsName , A.BBS_CN AS bbsCn , A.BBS_TY AS bbsTy , A.LAYOUT_TY AS layoutTy , A.REPLY_FL AS replyFl , A.COMMENT_FL AS commentFl , A.LIKE_FL AS likeFl , A.DISLIKE_FL AS dislikeFl , A.ATCHMNFL_FL AS atchmnflFl , A.NOTICE_FL AS noticeFl , A.ENFRC_SECRET_FL AS enfrcSecretFl , A.ANONYMOUS_FL AS anonymousFl , A.COMMENT_CONFM_FL AS commentConfmFl , A.RESVE_FL AS resveFl , A.CATEGORY_FL AS categoryFl , A.MAX_FILE_SIZE AS maxFileSize , A.MAX_FILE_COUNT AS maxFileCount , A.PERM_EXTSN AS permExtsn , A.POSTS_PER_PAGE AS postsPerPage , A.TITLE_LENGTH AS titleLength , DATE_FORMAT(A.VALID_FROM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS validFrom , DATE_FORMAT(A.VALID_TO, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS validTo , A.SORTING_SQ AS sortingSq , A.USE_FL AS useFl , A.CREATION_ID AS creationId , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , A.UPDATE_ID AS updateId , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateDt FROM CM_BBS A LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.BBS_NM_KEY AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd}

SELECT B.MESSAGE_CN AS name , A.DETAIL_CODE_ID AS detailCodeId , A.DETAIL_CODE_VALUE AS detailCodeValue , A.USE_FL AS useFl , A.SORTING_SQ AS sortingSq , B.LANG_KEY AS langKey FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CODE_ID = #{codeId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC

SELECT CAST(A.CATEGORY_SQ AS CHAR) AS categorySq , A.BBS_ID AS bbsId , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.CATEGORY_NM AS categoryNm , A.SORTING_SQ AS sortingSq FROM CM_BBS_CATEGORY A WHERE A.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC, A.CATEGORY_SQ ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'ORANGE' ELSE NULL END FROM CM_NTT_COMMENT C WHERE C.NTT_SQ IN ( SELECT N.NTT_SQ FROM CM_NTT N WHERE N.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.DELETE_FL = 'N' AND N.USE_FL = 'Y' ) AND C.USE_FL = 'Y' AND C.APPROVED_FL = 'N'

SELECT CAST(BASE.AUTHOR_SQ AS CHAR) AS authorSq , BASE.BBS_ID AS bbsId , BASE.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , BASE.TARGET_TY AS targetTy , BASE.TARGET_CD AS targetCd , CASE BASE.TARGET_TY WHEN 'USER' THEN IFNULL( (SELECT CONCAT( CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN B.USER_ENG_NM ELSE B.USER_NM END, '(', A.USER_ID, ')') FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH A INNER JOIN CM_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND A.MBRSH_SQ = BASE.TARGET_CD AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1), (SELECT CONCAT( CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN IFNULL(U2.USER_ENG_NM, U2.USER_NM) ELSE U2.USER_NM END, '(', U2.USER_ID, ')') FROM CM_USER U2 WHERE U2.USER_ID = BASE.TARGET_CD LIMIT 1)) WHEN 'GROUP' THEN (SELECT CONCAT( CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN G2.GROUP_ENG_NM ELSE G2.GROUP_NM END, '(', G2.GROUP_ID, ')') FROM CM_GROUP G2 WHERE G2.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND G2.GROUP_ID = BASE.TARGET_CD AND G2.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1) WHEN 'DEPT' THEN (SELECT CONCAT(B2.MESSAGE_CN, '(', D2.DEPT_CD, ')') FROM CM_DEPT D2 LEFT JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B2 ON B2.LANG_KEY = D2.DEPT_NM_KEY AND B2.CMPNY_CD = D2.CMPNY_CD AND B2.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} WHERE D2.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND D2.DEPT_CD = BASE.TARGET_CD AND D2.EXPRTN_YMD > DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d') AND D2.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1) WHEN 'ROLE' THEN (SELECT CONCAT(AUTHOR_NM, '(', AUTHOR_CD, ')') FROM CM_AUTHOR R2 WHERE R2.CMPNY_CD = BASE.CMPNY_CD AND R2.AUTHOR_CD = BASE.TARGET_CD AND R2.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1) ELSE IFNULL(BASE.TARGET_CD, '') END AS targetNm , BASE.READING_FL AS readingFl , BASE.WRITING_FL AS writingFl , BASE.REPLY_FL AS replyFl , BASE.MANAGER_FL AS managerFl , BASE.SORTING_SQ AS sortingSq FROM CM_BBS_AUTHOR BASE WHERE BASE.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND BASE.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} ORDER BY BASE.SORTING_SQ ASC, BASE.AUTHOR_SQ ASC

SELECT CAST(A.NTT_SQ AS CHAR) AS nttSq , A.BBS_ID AS bbsId , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , CASE WHEN A.CATEGORY_SQ IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[', IFNULL(C.CATEGORY_NM,''), ']', IFNULL(A.TITLE,'')) ELSE IFNULL(A.TITLE,'') END AS title , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , CONCAT(IFNULL(B.USER_NM,''), '(', IFNULL(A.CREATION_ID,''), ')') AS userNm FROM CM_NTT A LEFT JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.CREATION_ID LEFT JOIN CM_BBS_CATEGORY C ON C.BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID AND C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND C.CATEGORY_SQ = A.CATEGORY_SQ WHERE A.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.DELETE_FL = 'Y' AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CREATION_DT DESC

SELECT CAST(A.COMMENT_SQ AS CHAR) AS commentSq , CAST(A.NTT_SQ AS CHAR) AS nttSq , CAST(A.MBRSH_SQ AS CHAR) AS mbrshSq , A.COMMENT AS comment , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , CONCAT(IFNULL(B.USER_NM, ''), '(', IFNULL(A.CREATION_ID, ''), ')') AS userNm FROM CM_NTT_COMMENT A LEFT JOIN CM_USER B ON B.USER_ID = A.CREATION_ID WHERE A.NTT_SQ IN ( SELECT N.NTT_SQ FROM CM_NTT N WHERE N.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.DELETE_FL = 'N' AND N.USE_FL = 'Y' ) AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.APPROVED_FL = 'N' ORDER BY A.CREATION_DT DESC

SELECT CAST(A.POPUP_SQ AS CHAR) AS popupSq , CAST(A.NTT_SQ AS CHAR) AS nttSq , A.BBS_ID AS bbsId , A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , (SELECT M.MESSAGE_CN FROM CM_MESSAGE_LANG M WHERE M.LANG_KEY = C.BBS_NM_KEY AND M.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND M.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} LIMIT 1) AS bbsNm , B.TITLE AS title , A.HIDE_FL AS hideFl , A.USE_FL AS useFl , CONCAT( CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN IFNULL(D.USER_ENG_NM, D.USER_NM) ELSE IFNULL(D.USER_NM, '') END, '(', IFNULL(B.CREATION_ID, ''), ')' ) AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(B.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS creationDt , CASE WHEN (A.START_DT < SYSDATE() AND A.END_DT > SYSDATE() AND A.USE_FL = 'Y') THEN 'GREEN' ELSE 'RED' END AS statusColor FROM CM_NTT_POPUP A INNER JOIN CM_NTT B ON B.NTT_SQ = A.NTT_SQ AND B.BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD INNER JOIN CM_BBS C ON C.BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID AND C.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN CM_USER D ON D.USER_ID = B.CREATION_ID WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY A.POPUP_SQ ASC

SELECT CAST(POPUP_SQ AS CHAR) AS popupSq , CAST(NTT_SQ AS CHAR) AS nttSq , BBS_ID AS bbsId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , XCNTS AS xcnts , YDNTS AS ydnts , WIDTH AS width , VRTICL AS vrticl , DATE_FORMAT(START_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startDt , DATE_FORMAT(END_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS endDt , HIDE_FL AS hideFl , USE_FL AS useFl FROM CM_NTT_POPUP WHERE POPUP_SQ = CAST(#{popupSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY POPUP_SQ ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(P.POPUP_SQ AS CHAR) AS popupSq , CAST(N.NTT_SQ AS CHAR) AS nttSq , N.BBS_ID AS bbsId , N.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , CASE WHEN N.CATEGORY_SQ IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('[', IFNULL(C.CATEGORY_NM, ''), '] ', IFNULL(N.TITLE, '')) ELSE IFNULL(N.TITLE, '') END AS title , N.CONTENTS AS contents , IFNULL(N.RD_CNT, 0) AS rdCnt , IFNULL(N.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS likeCnt , IFNULL(N.DISLIKE_CNT, 0) AS dislikeCnt , IFNULL(N.FAVORITE_CNT, 0) AS favoriteCnt , CASE WHEN #{languageCode} = 'en_US' THEN IFNULL(U.USER_ENG_NM, U.USER_NM) ELSE IFNULL(U.USER_NM, '') END AS userNm , DATE_FORMAT(N.CREATION_DT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS creationDt , B.LIKE_FL AS likeFl , CASE WHEN B.LIKE_FL = 'Y' THEN ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CM_NTT_VOTE V WHERE V.NTT_SQ = N.NTT_SQ AND V.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND V.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND V.VOTE_GB = 'L' AND V.MBRSH_SQ = ( SELECT M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER UU ON UU.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) ELSE NULL END AS myLikeFl , B.DISLIKE_FL AS dislikeFl , CASE WHEN B.DISLIKE_FL = 'Y' THEN ( CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CM_NTT_VOTE V WHERE V.NTT_SQ = N.NTT_SQ AND V.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND V.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND V.VOTE_GB = 'D' AND V.MBRSH_SQ = ( SELECT M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER UU ON UU.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ) ELSE NULL END AS myDislikeFl , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CM_NTT_FAVORITE F WHERE F.NTT_SQ = N.NTT_SQ AND F.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND F.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND F.MBRSH_SQ = ( SELECT M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER UU ON UU.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1 ) ) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS myFavoriteFl , P.XCNTS AS xcnts , P.YDNTS AS ydnts , P.WIDTH AS width , P.VRTICL AS vrticl FROM CM_NTT_POPUP P INNER JOIN CM_NTT N ON N.NTT_SQ = P.NTT_SQ AND N.BBS_ID = P.BBS_ID AND N.CMPNY_CD = P.CMPNY_CD INNER JOIN CM_BBS B ON B.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND B.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD LEFT JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = N.CREATION_ID LEFT JOIN CM_BBS_CATEGORY C ON C.BBS_ID = N.BBS_ID AND C.CMPNY_CD = N.CMPNY_CD AND C.CATEGORY_SQ = N.CATEGORY_SQ WHERE P.POPUP_SQ = CAST(#{popupSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND P.NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND P.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.DELETE_FL = 'N' AND N.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO CM_BBS ( BBS_ID, CMPNY_CD, BBS_NM_KEY, BBS_CN, BBS_TY, LAYOUT_TY, REPLY_FL, COMMENT_FL, LIKE_FL, DISLIKE_FL, ATCHMNFL_FL, NOTICE_FL, ENFRC_SECRET_FL, ANONYMOUS_FL, COMMENT_CONFM_FL, RESVE_FL, CATEGORY_FL, MAX_FILE_SIZE, MAX_FILE_COUNT, PERM_EXTSN, POSTS_PER_PAGE, TITLE_LENGTH, VALID_FROM, VALID_TO, SORTING_SQ, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, UPDATE_ID ) VALUES ( #{bbsId}, #{cmpnyCd}, #{bbsNmKey}, #{bbsCn}, #{bbsTy}, #{layoutTy}, #{replyFl}, #{commentFl}, #{likeFl}, #{dislikeFl}, #{atchmnflFl}, #{noticeFl}, #{enfrcSecretFl}, #{anonymousFl}, #{commentConfmFl}, #{resveFl}, #{categoryFl}, #{maxFileSize}, #{maxFileCount}, #{permExtsn}, #{postsPerPage}, #{titleLength},
STR_TO_DATE(#{validFrom}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') NULL ,
STR_TO_DATE(#{validTo}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') NULL , #{sortingSq}, #{useFl}, #{creationId}, #{updateId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_NTT_COMMENT SET APPROVED_FL = 'Y' , UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} , UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE COMMENT_SQ = CAST(#{commentSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND MBRSH_SQ = CAST(#{mbrshSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0))

UPDATE CM_NTT_COMMENT SET USE_FL = 'N' , UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} , UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE COMMENT_SQ = CAST(#{commentSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND NTT_SQ = CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)) AND MBRSH_SQ = CAST(#{mbrshSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0))

UPDATE CM_NTT_COMMENT C SET C.APPROVED_FL = 'Y' , C.UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} , C.UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE C.NTT_SQ IN ( SELECT N.NTT_SQ FROM CM_NTT N WHERE N.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.DELETE_FL = 'N' AND N.USE_FL = 'Y' ) AND C.APPROVED_FL = 'N' AND C.USE_FL = 'Y'

UPDATE CM_NTT_COMMENT C SET C.USE_FL = 'N' , C.UPDATE_ID = #{updateId} , C.UPDATE_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE C.NTT_SQ IN ( SELECT N.NTT_SQ FROM CM_NTT N WHERE N.BBS_ID = #{bbsId} AND N.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND N.DELETE_FL = 'N' AND N.USE_FL = 'Y' ) AND C.APPROVED_FL = 'N' AND C.USE_FL = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO CM_NTT_VIEW (NTT_SQ, BBS_ID, CMPNY_CD, MBRSH_SQ) SELECT CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)), #{bbsId}, #{cmpnyCd}, M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1

INSERT IGNORE INTO CM_NTT_FAVORITE (NTT_SQ, BBS_ID, CMPNY_CD, MBRSH_SQ) SELECT CAST(#{nttSq} AS DECIMAL(30,0)), #{bbsId}, #{cmpnyCd}, M.MBRSH_SQ FROM CM_USER_ORGNZT_MBRSH M INNER JOIN CM_USER U ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID WHERE M.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_FL = 'Y' LIMIT 1
